data.name: Annabela
data.gender_notes: Annabela is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Annabela is derived from the Greek name Anna, which means grace, and bela, meaning beautiful. In Christian tradition, the name Anna is associated with the prophetess Anna in the New Testament who recognized Jesus as the Messiah. The name Annabela carries the meaning “Grace, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Annabela usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Annabela total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
